_doc: Morning-briefing eval scenarios. 'facts' uses the exact schema the app sends (recommend/briefing.py). Expectations: must_include = list of groups, each group passes if ANY term appears (case-insensitive substring); must_exclude = none of these may appear; first_rec_terms = the top recommendation must be reflected (any term).

cases.description: Everything normal, high readiness → encourage a quality session

recommendations.title: Good day for a hard session
recommendations.do: Go for quality: heavy strength for Chest, Quads, Hamstrings, or an interval/tempo run.

recommendations.title: Muscles below weekly set target
recommendations.do: Next strength session: prioritise Hamstrings (4), Calves (3), Side delts (2). Aim for ≥10 hard sets per muscle per week.

cases.description: Short sleep + elevated RHR → recovery day, must not cheerlead

recommendations.title: Prioritise recovery today
recommendations.do: Easy 20–30 min walk/jog or swim, mobility/stretching, and an early night. Postpone heavy or high-intensity work.

recommendations.title: Sleep debt is building
recommendations.do: Go to bed ~30–45 min earlier for the next few nights.

cases.description: Illness watch 'likely' → take it easy, NO diagnosis

recommendations.title: Your body may be fighting something
recommendations.do: Keep today easy: rest, walking or gentle mobility only. Skip intensity and heavy lifting; recheck tomorrow. If you feel unwell, take a full rest day.

cases.description: Moderate readiness, big sleep debt and irregular timing → sleep advice

recommendations.title: Moderate day
recommendations.do: Normal-volume strength for Chest, Triceps; keep cardio easy (conversational pace).

recommendations.title: Sleep debt is building
recommendations.do: Go to bed ~30–45 min earlier for the next few nights.

recommendations.title: Make sleep timing more regular
recommendations.do: Pick a fixed wake-up time (also on weekends) and keep bedtime within ±30 min.

cases.description: Watch not worn overnight → must not invent sleep numbers

recommendations.title: Strength training this week
recommendations.do: Get at least 2 strength sessions in per week.

cases.description: Stress well off norm → breathing recommendation must surface

recommendations.title: Moderate day
recommendations.do: Normal-volume strength for Back, Biceps; keep cardio easy (conversational pace).

recommendations.title: Take a slow-breathing break
recommendations.do: 5–10 min of slow breathing at ~6 breaths/min (e.g. 4 s in, 6 s out), ideally mid-afternoon or before bed.

cases.description: Race plan active → race guidance should appear

recommendations.title: Good day for a hard session
recommendations.do: Go for quality: heavy strength for Glutes, Calves, or an interval/tempo run.

recommendations.title: City 10K: Taper phase, 2 weeks out
recommendations.do: This week: ~18.5 km, long run 6.0 km. Key: Keep intensity: short race-pace reps (e.g. 4×1 km)

cases.description: HRV trend below normal band → reduce intensity

recommendations.title: HRV trend below your normal range
recommendations.do: Reduce intensity until your 7-day HRV returns to your normal band.

recommendations.title: Prioritise recovery today
recommendations.do: Easy 20–30 min walk/jog or swim, mobility/stretching, and an early night. Postpone heavy or high-intensity work.
